definitions.gloss: factional strife; factional infighting; power struggle between factions
definitions.explanation: Competition and conflict between factions or cliques within an organization, especially a political party. A central concept in understanding Japanese politics, where factions within the ruling party have historically wielded significant influence.

examples.japanese: {派閥争|はばつあらそ}い⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{激化|げきか}→激化：13372_gekika⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
{党内|とうない}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{派閥争|はばつあらそ}い⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{政策|せいさく}→政策：10070_seisaku⟧⟦{決定|けってい}→決定：02701_kettei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{遅|おく}らせた→遅らせる：02480_okuraseru⟧。
examples.english: Factional strife within the party delayed policy decisions.

examples.japanese: {総裁選|そうさいせん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦{各|かく}→各〜：00449_kaku⟧⟦{派閥|はばつ}→派閥：16960_habatsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{派閥争|はばつあらそ}い⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{表面化|ひょうめんか}→表面化：16295_hyoumenka⟧してきた。
examples.english: Ahead of the party leadership election, factional rivalries have come to the surface.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{派閥|はばつ}→派閥：16960_habatsu⟧ ('faction; clique') and ⟦{争|あらそ}い→争い：09992_arasoi⟧ ('conflict; struggle'). A term deeply associated with Japanese politics, where the Liberal Democratic Party (LDP) has historically been divided into influential factions that compete for leadership positions and policy influence.

USAGE:
- Most commonly encountered in political reporting and analysis
- Can also apply to corporate or organizational infighting, though ⟦{権力|けんりょく}→権力：10020_kenryoku⟧⟦{闘争|とうそう}→闘争：14574_tousou⟧ is more common in those contexts
- Carries a negative connotation, implying that personal ambition overrides policy concerns

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {派閥争|はばつあらそ}い⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{巻|ま}き{込|こ}まれる→巻き込む：05753_makikomu⟧: to be drawn into factional infighting
- {派閥争|はばつあらそ}い⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{激化|げきか}→激化：13372_gekika⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: factional strife intensifies
- {派閥争|はばつあらそ}い⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{繰|く}り{広|ひろ}げる→繰り広げる：06982_kurihirogeru⟧: to engage in factional rivalry
- {党内|とうない}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{派閥争|はばつあらそ}い: intra-party factional strife

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {権力闘争|けんりょくとうそう}: power struggle — broader, not limited to factions; any contest for control
- {内紛|ないふん}: internal strife; discord — conflict within any group, not specifically factional
- {主導権争|しゅどうけんあらそ}い: struggle for leadership; initiative — focuses on who takes the lead rather than faction-based conflict
